system.description:
Use this when the target receives HP damage. Lose any number of [Illusion Weapons] tags as the cost. The number of HP damage that the target will receive is [(POW Mod) × [number of Illusion Weapons] tags used].

Magic that uses illusion weapons to block enemy attacks. It can be used in various ways, such as changing its shape into a shield, cutting down incoming arrows and magic, but the phantom weapon used disappears
